name: reproseed
description: Reproduce difficult bugs, minimize failing scenarios, and generate reliable regression tests.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-export-assets.mjs
scripts.test:runner: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/runner/safety.test.ts test/runner/replay.test.ts test/runner/minimize-live.test.ts test/runner/stale-search.test.ts test/runner/stale-minimize.test.ts test/runner/minimize-duration-live.test.ts
scripts.test:browsers: npm run test:demo && npm run test:search && npm run test:runner && npm run test:export && npm run test:cli:e2e
